plain.li: [trigger:death] I dug a grave this morning. {OTHER_nameDef} had breakfast carried to {OTHER_objective} in the cell.
{OTHER_nameDef} counts the guards through the bars at every change of shift. I've watched {OTHER_objective} do it all week.
[night] I lie awake listening for the cell door. One bad latch, and {OTHER_nameDef} is standing over somebody's bed.

warm.li: [grieving] I'm not a cruel person. I'm just tired of walking past {OTHER_nameDef} on my way to the graves.
There are people here I'd die for. I won't gamble them on {OTHER_nameDef} having a change of heart.

blunt.li: [trigger:raid] {OTHER_nameDef} shot at me yesterday. Today I'm supposed to carry {OTHER_objective} soup. No.
[trait:Bloodlust] I've picked out the spot, behind the trash heap. Say yes and I'll see to it myself.
The cell isn't an inn. Deal with {OTHER_nameDef}.

cheerful.li: We could have {OTHER_nameDef}'s cell empty by supper if the council says yes! That's one less bowl to carry down every night.
[trigger:raid] We won the fight! There's one raider left over, sitting in our cell, and I say we finish the job.

gloomy.li: [trigger:death] There's an empty chair at supper now, and every night a full bowl still goes down to {OTHER_nameDef}.
I keep dreaming that {OTHER_nameDef} gets out. I hear the cell door in the dream and can't make myself get up.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I'll do it myself if the others are squeamish. It won't cost me any sleep.
[trigger:raid] As long as {OTHER_nameDef} is in that cell, {OTHER_possessive} friends have a reason to come back. I'd rather they had none.

plain.li: [trigger:death] I'll go out to the grave and tell them it's done.

warm.li: [grieving] It doesn't bring anyone back, I know. I just needed to stop seeing that face every day.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Over too quick. It'll do.

cheerful.li: Now we can get the smell out of that cell!

gloomy.li: [promised] You kept your word about {OTHER_nameDef}, and now there's one less thing to dream about.

cold.li: One less mouth and a warden with free hours. I've already reassigned them in my head.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] Then I'll sit outside {OTHER_nameDef}'s cell at night with a weapon across my knees.

warm.li: [trusting] You've been right before, and I hope this is one of those times.

blunt.li: [bitter] So the raider in the cell counts for more than the ones we buried.

gloomy.li: [grieving] I'll take the long way to the graves now, so I don't pass the cell.

cold.li: Noted. When {OTHER_nameDef} escapes, I'd like the record to show who argued for what.

plain.li: [night] {OTHER_nameDef} sat in the cell humming tonight, the same tune over and over. I thought the council should know.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] I sharpen my knife outside the cell now, where {OTHER_nameDef} can see.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has eaten better this week than the people guarding {OTHER_objective}. I've kept count of every meal.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked me what season it was. I told {OTHER_objective}, and {OTHER_pronoun} just nodded and went back to staring at the wall.
[repeat] I asked about {OTHER_nameDef} before. Nothing in that cell has changed, except how thin {OTHER_pronoun} looks.
[night] At night you can hear {OTHER_nameDef} through the wall, saying names none of us know. Let {OTHER_objective} go home to them.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has people somewhere who don't know if {OTHER_pronoun} is alive. Let's send {OTHER_objective} back to them.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} drew me a house through the bars, with a dog in the yard. Can't we let {OTHER_objective} go home to it?
[grieving] I've buried enough people this year. I'd like to send one home instead.

blunt.li: We're not running a zoo. That cell has held {OTHER_nameDef} long enough.
[afterraid] I know what just happened. {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't in that raid, {OTHER_pronoun} was in a cell. Let {OTHER_objective} go.

cheerful.li: Let's see {OTHER_nameDef} walk out of there smiling! I'll pack {OTHER_objective} a lunch.
I've been playing pebbles with {OTHER_nameDef} through the bars, and I lose every game! I'd rather lose to {OTHER_objective} somewhere without bars.

gloomy.li: [old] I was a prisoner once, when I was young. I can still hear that lock when I close my eyes.
{OTHER_nameDef} talks less every day in there. By winter there won't be much of {OTHER_objective} left to let go.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} costs us a warden and a meal a day and gives nothing back.
I don't like a locked room full of resentment next to where I sleep.

plain.li: The cell's empty and there's no new grave. A good day.

warm.li: [trait:Kind] Whatever comes next for {OTHER_nameDef}, it isn't a cell.

blunt.li: One prisoner out of that cell alive, for a change.

cheerful.li: [promised] You promised, and {OTHER_nameDef} is out of that cell!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s people will probably shoot at us again someday. I'll still be glad we did this.

cold.li: Alive and out of the cell, which is worth more to us than a grave.

plain.li: [promised] I told {OTHER_nameDef} it would be soon. I'm going to have to stop saying soon.

warm.li: [night] I sat by the cell tonight so {OTHER_nameDef} wouldn't be alone. It's all I can do for {OTHER_objective} now.

blunt.li: [bitter] This council could find a key if it wanted to. It doesn't want to.

cheerful.li: Then I'll visit {OTHER_nameDef} every day and bring {OTHER_objective} the news! It beats sitting in silence.

gloomy.li: So {OTHER_nameDef} stays in the cell until {OTHER_pronoun} dies there.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked after the council today, and I said you were thinking it over.
{OTHER_nameDef} has stopped asking me when {OTHER_pronoun} can go home.

warm.li: [trusting] I know you'll do right by {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm only bringing it up because the cell is so cold.

gloomy.li: [winter] The cell gets colder every week, and {OTHER_nameDef} has started sleeping sitting up.

plain.li: [afterraid] Since the raid, people keep to themselves, cleaning the same weapon over and over. Let's get them all in one room for a night.
[rain] The fields are too wet to work today anyway. We could spend the afternoon together and call it a party.
All we've talked about for weeks is food and raiders. One evening about anything else would do us good.

warm.li: [skill:Social] I've noticed who's been eating alone lately. A party gets them to the table without anybody making a fuss.
[grieving] We should all sit down together one evening and talk about them. I don't want to do it alone.

blunt.li: People have been glaring at each other for a week. Let them glare over a drink instead.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't like most of you. I like you better drunk, though, so throw a party.
[poor] We're broke, I know. A fire and some noise don't cost anything.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing a dance behind the storeroom! It's mostly elbows, but I'd like people to see it.
[winter] Picture us all packed in around the hearth with the snow coming down, telling stories! Let's have a party before winter drags on any longer.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I can't remember the last time I heard laughing in this place. A party might help, or it might not.
[night] The nights here are so quiet you start listening for things. I'd like one night loud enough to drown them out.

cold.li: Three people have snapped at me this week. I'd rather they danced it off.
[trait:Psychopath] People say things at a party they'd never say sober. I'd like to hear those things.

plain.li: [morning] There's still someone asleep under the table, and the floor's sticky. Good party.

warm.li: I saw people talking tonight who haven't said a word to each other all season. That's worth a sore head.

blunt.li: Don't tell anyone I danced.

cheerful.li: [promised] You promised a party, and it was a good one! I danced until my feet gave out.

gloomy.li: Tomorrow it's back to work and rice. Tonight was good, though.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] Useful evening. I know now who talks too much after two drinks.

plain.li: My good shirt can go back in the chest.

warm.li: Never mind, I'll go round and sit with people one at a time instead.

blunt.li: [bitter] The council doesn't do fun. The council does lists.

cheerful.li: I'll sing while I work instead, and people can join in if they like!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'd only have stood in a corner anyway.

plain.li: [evening] Another evening of eating fast and going straight to bed, so about that party.

cheerful.li: I've hung ribbons in the dining room! They'd look better with a party under them.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] The mood around here keeps getting worse, so I'm bringing up the party again.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s boots are still by the door where {OTHER_pronoun} left them. I want {OTHER_objective} back to wear them.
[night] I keep thinking I hear {OTHER_nameDef} coming in late from the fields. Then I remember where {OTHER_pronoun} is.
[repeat] I ask every trader who comes through about {SUBJECT}. I'm asking the council again too.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} always saved me a seat at supper. I've been saving {OTHER_objective} one since {OTHER_pronoun} was taken.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} said {OTHER_pronoun} would teach me to whistle. When is {OTHER_pronoun} coming back?

blunt.li: Every day we sit here is a day {SUBJECT} keeps {OTHER_nameDef}.
[afterraid] They dragged {OTHER_nameDef} out of our own yard. We go after {OTHER_objective} now, while the trail's fresh.
[skill:Shooting] I can hit a squirrel across the valley. Get me within range of {SUBJECT}'s camp and I'll do the rest.

cheerful.li: When {OTHER_nameDef} gets home I'm cooking a feast! I've already planned every dish, down to the pudding.
[highmood] I bet {OTHER_nameDef} is giving {SUBJECT} a terrible time! Let's go and bring {OTHER_objective} home.

gloomy.li: [grieving] We've dug too many graves lately. {OTHER_nameDef} is still alive, as far as we know.
[winter] It's freezing at night now. I hope they've given {OTHER_nameDef} a blanket over there.

cold.li: Every week with {SUBJECT}, {OTHER_nameDef} gets thinner and weaker. Fetch {OTHER_objective} while it's still worth the trip.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't miss people. I do notice when things are taken from me. {OTHER_nameDef} was taken from me.

plain.li: [night] I'll be checking on {OTHER_nameDef} all night, just to see {OTHER_pronoun}'s there.

warm.li: [promised] You said we'd bring {OTHER_nameDef} home, and you did. I won't forget it.

blunt.li: Next time {SUBJECT} takes one of ours, we do this again.

cheerful.li: Somebody pinch me, {OTHER_nameDef} is really here!

gloomy.li: Whatever happened over there, {OTHER_nameDef} can tell it when {OTHER_pronoun}'s ready.

cold.li: Recovered, mostly intact. Now let's discuss what {SUBJECT} owes us.

plain.li: [promised] I told {OTHER_nameDef} we'd come. Wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is now, I hope {OTHER_pronoun} stopped waiting.

warm.li: I'll keep {OTHER_nameDef}'s things in a box under my bed, in case {OTHER_pronoun} finds a way home.

blunt.li: [bitter] {OTHER_nameDef} would have come for any one of you. Remember that the next time you need someone.

gloomy.li: [night] I keep picturing {OTHER_nameDef} watching the road for us every evening.

cold.li: So {OTHER_nameDef} is a loss. I'll stop setting aside {OTHER_possessive} share of the food.

plain.li: [snow] It's snowing, and {OTHER_nameDef} hates the cold.

warm.li: [trusting] I know a rescue takes planning. I'd just like to hear that the plan exists.

blunt.li: [bitter] Still waiting on {OTHER_nameDef}, unless the council has forgotten {OTHER_objective} too.

plain.li: [skill:Shooting] Lately the only thing I shoot at is raiders. Something that doesn't shoot back would make a nice change.
[poor] The stores are thin, and there's game out past the fields. I don't see what we're waiting for.
[fog] Low fog and the wind in my face. I could walk right up to anything in this.

warm.li: The cooks have been making the same meal out of the same sack for a week. Let me bring them something to work with.
[old] My eyes are still good at a distance, even if they're useless for reading. Put them to use while they last.

blunt.li: I've cleaned this weapon three times this week. It's time it got used.
[trait:Bloodlust] It's been quiet too long. Send me after an animal before I start a fight in here.
[winter] The game's fat and slow in the snow, right past our walls. I'll take one down.

cheerful.li: Let me go hunting! I'll bring back the biggest thing I can drag home.
[spring] Everything's out and about this spring! Give me a day and I'll bring a few back.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I want to sit out in the brush all day and wait for something to wander past. It's the only time my head goes quiet.
Everything out there dies of something, hunger or wolves or the winter. A clean kill is kinder than any of those.

cold.li: [skill:Shooting] A clean shot through the lungs at range. The animal barely knows. I'd like to keep my hand in.
[trait:Psychopath] I find it calming. The breathing, the waiting, the moment it stops. I'll bring the meat back, of course.

plain.li: [morning] Dawn, a still field, and one clean shot.

warm.li: The best cut goes to whoever's been working hardest this week. I'll tell the cook.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] That helped. I'm calmer now.

cheerful.li: [promised] You let me go, and I got one! It took three tries, but I got it.

gloomy.li: It looked right at me just before I shot. I'll eat it anyway.

cold.li: [skill:Shooting] Through the heart, at long range. I'd like the butcher to note how little meat was spoiled.

plain.li: The game out there gets another week.

blunt.li: [bitter] So I go back to cleaning a weapon I never get to use.

cheerful.li: I'll practice on fence posts until you change your mind!

gloomy.li: I'll watch them graze from the wall and eat rice.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] Unfortunate. The urge doesn't leave just because the hunt never came.

plain.li: [outside] That animal's back by the far fence again, just pointing it out.

blunt.li: My weapon's clean and my boots are on, and I'm still standing here.

cheerful.li: I've picked out the one I want, the big one with the torn ear! Just say when.

plain.li: I've lost track of the weather. I have to ask whoever comes in from the fields.
[rain] I can hear the rain on the rock above us. I'd like to feel it instead.
[skill:Plants] Put me on the fields for a day. I don't mind what's planted, I just want dirt under my nails.

warm.li: If anything needs carrying in from the far field, I'll take it. The long way round.
[child] Can I go and play outside? Just for a bit? I'll stay where you can see me.
[old] Let me sit in the sun for an afternoon, while my legs can still get me out there.

blunt.li: I've stared at these walls for weeks. Let me out.
[winter] I don't care how cold it is. Give me a shovel and send me out to clear the paths.

cheerful.li: I want to stand in the middle of a field and spin until I fall over!
[snow] It's snowing out and I'm stuck in here! Let me go and make tracks in it.

gloomy.li: [night] I dreamed about the sky last night. Woke up, and the ceiling was still there.
We dug into the rock to stay safe, and I haven't seen the sun in nine days.

cold.li: People who never see daylight start making mistakes. I've noticed mine. You'll notice them soon.
[trait:Psychopath] The others are starting to irritate me. It would be better for them if I spent some time outside.

plain.li: [rain] Got soaked to the skin. Best afternoon in weeks.

warm.li: [old] I sat on a rock and let the sun find me. Thank you for giving me the time.

blunt.li: Better. Don't put me back underground for a while.

cheerful.li: I saw a bird, a real one, sitting on the fence! It didn't care about me at all.

gloomy.li: The sky was gray and the wind smelled of smoke. I stayed out there until my hands went numb.

cold.li: [promised] Outdoor time, as promised. My concentration has already improved.

plain.li: [indoors] I've started drawing windows on the wall with charcoal.

warm.li: [trusting] I'll wait. I know there's work that needs doing first.

blunt.li: [bitter] Keep me in the hole, then. I'll be pale and angry, and it'll be your fault.

gloomy.li: So I stay down here. I'm getting used to the dark.

cold.li: Very well. When I break, remember that I asked.

plain.li: [indoors,day] Is it sunny out? Someone said it might be. I wouldn't know.

cheerful.li: Still inside! I keep asking the haulers what the sky's doing today.

gloomy.li: [winter] Another week indoors. My skin's the color of the walls now.

plain.li: I check the {SUBJECT} in the storeroom every morning. There's less each time.
[morning] Woke up shaking again. Not badly. Just enough that I couldn't hold the spoon.
[repeat] I'm asking about the {SUBJECT} again, and I'm still asking politely.

warm.li: I'm not proud of it. But I'm a better friend on {SUBJECT} than off it, and you've all seen me off it.
[trusting] Lock it up and hand it out fairly, I trust you with that. I just need there to be something to hand out.

blunt.li: [trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] I'm not asking to be saved. I'm asking for a full shelf.
Don't look at me like that. Keep the shelf stocked and you won't have to.
[hurt] I'm in pieces already, and you want me to go without {SUBJECT} too? Pick one.

cheerful.li: I'm a much nicer person with {SUBJECT} on the shelf! Ask anyone who's seen me without it.
[highmood] Feeling good today, and the {SUBJECT} has a lot to do with that! Let's keep some in stock.

gloomy.li: [night] Nights are the worst without it. The thoughts all arrive at once, and none of them are kind.
[lowmood] I know where this ends up. Until then, I just want to get through the days.

cold.li: I function normally on {SUBJECT}. Without it, I don't function. Decide which colonist you want.
[trait:Psychopath] Withdrawal makes me worse to be around than I already am. You don't want to see it.

plain.li: The shelf's stocked. I slept through the night.

warm.li: [promised] You kept your word on something most people would have lectured me about. Thank you for not lecturing.

blunt.li: Good. Now stop watching me take it.

cheerful.li: Look at my hands! Steady enough to thread a needle.

gloomy.li: The shaking's stopped. That'll do for now.

cold.li: Stock is adequate. I'll ration it myself. I'm better at it than anyone you'd assign.

plain.li: [promised] I was told there'd be {SUBJECT} on the shelf. There's dust on the shelf.

blunt.li: [bitter] So I sweat it out with the whole place watching. Thanks for that.

cheerful.li: Well, I'm getting clean whether I like it or not! Somebody keep an eye on me this week.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's coming. The shakes, the sweats, the rest of it. I'll try not to be too loud.

cold.li: Withdrawal begins shortly. I'd suggest assigning someone you don't like to supervise me.

plain.li: The shelf's still low on {SUBJECT}. I check it more often than I should.
I've been stretching what's left of the {SUBJECT}. It won't stretch much further.

blunt.li: I'm being patient. You can tell because nothing's broken yet.

gloomy.li: [night] Another bad night. I'm not asking for sympathy. I'm asking about the {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I can't remember last season clearly. I'd like to remember the next one.
[trait:Teetotaler] I used to lecture people who touched the stuff. Now I'm hooked on it myself. Help me get off it.
[morning] I wake up already thinking about it. I'd like to wake up thinking about breakfast, like a normal person.

warm.li: Someone here looks up to me. I want to be worth it.
[trusting] If anyone can keep me honest, it's this council. Lock it up, and keep the key somewhere I'd never look.

blunt.li: I'm going to be awful for a while. Hide the {SUBJECT}, hide the sharp things, and don't take it personally.
[trait:Abrasive] Yes, I'll be meaner than usual. Yes, that's possible. Do it anyway.
[hurt] I'm already in pain. Might as well get the withdrawal over with while I'm at it.

cheerful.li: I've made up my mind to quit! It'll be a rough couple of weeks, and I'd like you all on my side.
[spring] Everything's starting over this spring, and I want to as well! No more {SUBJECT}.

gloomy.li: [night] Some nights I add up how much of my life went to {SUBJECT}, and then I want some.
[old] I've buried friends who never quit. I don't want to be next.

cold.li: My judgment slips whenever I'm due for a dose. That's unacceptable in someone who carries a weapon.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't tolerate anything having a hold on me. Not people, and not {SUBJECT}. Cut it off.

plain.li: [morning] Woke up and didn't reach for anything. Just got up and went to breakfast.

warm.li: [promised] You said you'd see me through it, and you did, even the night I said those things. Sorry about those things.

blunt.li: Done. Clean. The next person who offers me {SUBJECT} gets hit.

cheerful.li: I can taste food again! Even the rice is good.

gloomy.li: The craving's gone. It left a quiet behind that I don't quite know what to do with yet.

cold.li: Clean. My hands are steady, and my decisions are my own again.

plain.li: [promised] Someone handed me {SUBJECT} again, and I took it. I'm not blaming anyone. I'm just telling you.

warm.li: [trusting] I'll try again on my own. It's harder alone, but you've all got enough on your plates.

blunt.li: [bitter] The next time someone asks why I'm still hooked, I'm sending them to the council.

gloomy.li: Still hooked. I think it's what people will remember about me.

cold.li: The attempt failed. I'll stop asking the colony to help with things it won't help with.

plain.li: [repeat] It still has its hooks in me. I'm still trying. Keep it out of my hands.

warm.li: [trusting] Every day I don't take it is partly thanks to you lot. Please keep it that way.

gloomy.li: [night] Bad night. Didn't give in. Don't make it easy for me tomorrow.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} gets up before dawn and does stretches, grunting at every one.
[night] I sleep with my back to the wall now so I can keep an eye on {OTHER_nameDef}. I was less tired on night watch.
[winter] Indoors with {OTHER_nameDef} all day and in the same room all night, the whole winter long. I won't last.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I might get along fine if we weren't sharing a bedroom.
[trusting] I don't want to make trouble for {OTHER_nameDef}. I'd just like to stop waking up angry.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] Either {OTHER_nameDef} moves out or I throw {OTHER_possessive} things in the mud.
{OTHER_nameDef} grinds {OTHER_possessive} teeth all night. Get {OTHER_objective} out of my room.
[repeat] I asked nicely last time. This is me asking less nicely.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I finally agree on something! We'd both like our own rooms.
[highmood] I'm in a good mood for once, and I'd like to keep it past bedtime! Please move {OTHER_nameDef}, or me.

gloomy.li: I fall asleep to {OTHER_nameDef} sighing at me and wake up to the same.
[lowmood] Some nights I'd rather sleep outside with the bugs than share air with {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: I've already thought through how this ends if we keep sharing a room. Separate us, and none of the endings happen.
[trait:Psychopath] {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps very deeply. I've noticed. You should move {OTHER_objective} before I notice anything else.

plain.li: [morning] I opened my eyes this morning and {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't the first thing I saw.

warm.li: Now that we have our own rooms, I said good morning to {OTHER_nameDef} and meant it.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] About time. {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't set foot in my room again.

cheerful.li: [promised] Separate rooms, just like you said! {OTHER_nameDef} and I even ate lunch together today.

gloomy.li: I still can't sleep. But at least it's my own thoughts keeping me up now, not {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: Separated. The odds of an incident have dropped considerably.

plain.li: [night] Still sharing with {OTHER_nameDef}. I've started sleeping with one boot on.

warm.li: I'll try harder with {OTHER_nameDef}. Someone has to, and I suppose it's me.

blunt.li: [bitter] Don't ask me about it when one of us turns up with a black eye.

gloomy.li: So it's {OTHER_nameDef} and me in that room until one of us dies.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] Understood. I'll handle the problem myself. You won't need to do anything.

plain.li: [night] {OTHER_nameDef} talked in {OTHER_possessive} sleep again. I heard my name, and some words after it.
[night] {OTHER_nameDef} left the door open again last night, and the cold came in until morning.

blunt.li: [repeat] Still sharing a room with {OTHER_nameDef}, and still not happy about it.

gloomy.li: [winter] Long nights in a small room with {OTHER_nameDef}. Spring is a long way off.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] Today I stitched a wound with thread meant for shirts, because that's all we had.
[winter] Flu season is coming. When it gets here, I want more on the shelf than a few bandages.
[skill:Medicine] I count the medicine every morning. It's a short count.

warm.li: Whenever someone limps in, I look at the shelf before I look at them. I hate that.
[old] I've lost patients to bad luck and bad aim. I'd hate to lose one to an empty shelf.

blunt.li: Everybody here gets hurt sooner or later. Stock up on medicine.
[trigger:raid] I'm out. Properly out. The next one who gets shot can bite down on a stick.
[poor] Sell the rug if you have to. Buy medicine.

cheerful.li: A full medicine shelf would be wonderful! I'd sleep so much better knowing it's there.
I sorted the shelf this morning! It didn't take long, since there's hardly anything on it.

gloomy.li: [night] I keep dreaming I run out of medicine halfway through an operation. Then I get up and check the shelf.
[grieving] I keep thinking about what I could have done with one more dose.

cold.li: A colonist who dies of infection is a colonist we fed, trained and armed for nothing. Medicine costs less than that.
[trigger:raid] Today's wounded went through most of our stock. The next raid will find us with almost nothing.

plain.li: [skill:Medicine] I reorganized the shelf twice, just because I could.

warm.li: I'll sleep tonight. Whatever comes through the door tomorrow, I can do something about it.

blunt.li: Good. Go get shot, if you have to. I'm ready now.

cheerful.li: [promised] Full shelves, like you promised! Hands off unless you're bleeding.

gloomy.li: Plenty of medicine now. Someone will need all of it before long.

cold.li: [trigger:raid] Restocked. Our odds for the next raid are back where I want them.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] Next time I'll be patching people up with rags and boiled water.

warm.li: I'll make do. I just hate making do when someone's bleeding on the table.

blunt.li: [bitter] Fine. When you bleed, don't come to me. Go bleed on the council.

gloomy.li: I'll keep the empty shelf dusted. It's the only thing in the infirmary I can take care of.

cold.li: I'll start triaging by usefulness, then. You may not like where you rank.

plain.li: [repeat] The shelf's still thin. I'm still the one who has to look at it.
